notes.title: Out now!
notes.content:
Well, what can I say!

Today is the day. After five years of long work, in the end finally at last!

The patches have been coming non-stop, working tirelessly to add major features even a week before this Release! 

To see some of the latest changes, see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1595110/view/529844242184405154]this[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1595110/view/508457312081412097]that[/url] update page. And of course expect many more to come 

Don't forget to leave a review, and join the Discord (click the button at the bottom of this page)! Can't wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Revelation of Release (Pt 2)
notes.content:
Hola,

The release now lies less than a week in the future! And today brings another big update, with two main features.

The biggest one: A Rewatch System! You can now click on a tiny little button in the top right, to repeat the visuals of the last unit movement that happened. This does not sound like much, but it was actually a monumental coding effort, taking over a week of 10+ hours coding days, requiring code reworks for more or less any single unit. But it is actually done now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/d339e88dbf87342d969c91b803dc80a54c2df691.gif[/img]

Secondy, there was a Reworked of the visuals of the unit placing UI. There are now bases the units stand on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/64471f6af842c71adae7307649cbc3339ec20cc5.jpg[/img]

Of course there are some QoL and bugfixes as well:
[list]
[*] Overhead UI also now shows 0 and negative HP if always show HP option is activated (this happens briefly after a unit is killed)
[*] Fixed Fallen Deluder and Lung of Mythenmetz having parts of their model turn into brass that should not exis.
[*] Fixed Xuhivan water freezing when stepped on not actually changing the ground, instead of just doing visuals
[*] Fixed a weird lighting square on the ground bug in the library
[*] Fixed Phoenix attack pattern
[*] Added the game's name and a logo to the taskbar
[/list]

[h2]Addendum of 16th of June[/h2]
Another Update! Right before release, ha! With two briefly describable changes: 
There is now a "Classic Visual Rotation" option in the settings menu. This will make the right mouse cube rotation feel more in line with what you might expect from other [strike]Rubik's[/strike] Twistable Magic Cube programs. I strongly feel that this option is subpar to standard movement, as it tends to make the cube end up in a position that is not "square" and tends to change the viewing angle of the cube face you are trying to look at. But if you prefer that, no judgment of you, just click the option!

On the other hand, the visual movement of your units now starts a tiny bit earlier than those of enemy units, to make it more clear how the movement actually works (your units first, then enemies, but deaths only happen at the end of movement). This was not as much of a monumental task as the Rewatch system, but still took a lot of coding reworks. So, enjoy! See you on Wednesday.

notes.title: Revelation of Release (of Early Access)
notes.content:
Woho!

[b]18th of June[/b]. That's it! That's the Steam Early Access release!

After all of those long years, it's finally time! Xuhivan's Autonomous Cube is coming to the big stage!

To celebrate this, here comes: Another massive update, including some requested reworks and lots of QoL!

[h2]General Gameplay Changes[/h2]
Listening to player feedback, the unit movement has been reworked: Your units now take priority when moving, such that blocking and units getting stuck is now much rarer. On a technical level, this means that your units move first, and the opponent units thereafter. Yet a unit can always do its own movement, and will only die after all teams have finished their movement-so enemies can still retaliate, beware!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/158e57ffc8a263c15f6e4c25479a5f4f5e59b8ad.gif[/img]

For reference, this was old behaviour:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/eb76dac99e51ac5c6623805868d123d4998ed0fe.gif[/img]
On the same note, the Orb of Love Mechanic was removed, all units now always turn when they hit an obstacle. You guys just seem too stupid to play the game the way I designed it. -,- What can I do. Maybe those mechanics will return in some format or another???? (Yes, this is a threat)

To make the game even easier (Ha!), there now also exists a thing called Déjà-Vu Potion:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/56100065dec6d72e18c9efb22f8fc23317a40671.jpg[/img]
You will automatically gain this relic after beating the first boss, Tasanzang. It allows you to restart one cube, while keeping all permanent changes such as clock and used relic charges as they are, so it's like a one-time get out of jail card when you have run into a roadblock, or a bad enemy spawn.

[h2]Unit Variants[/h2]
Completely reworked enemy unit spawns. There are now three variants for each cube, secretly unlocked along with the other stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/d0d16fa99c298e10fa2e6adef726345e34c6bafb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/dcab77d4d7e3a558e23a4845e1d9d29b9b4ea802.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/8c8daefdc3679a3eb7ab4797a29ea93486938d2d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Overworld Refurbishment[/h2]
Also, the Overworld got partly reworked, and completely refurbished in act 2 and 3. Some nasty lighting bugs haven been fixed, especially noticeable before on the roof of act 3. A plattform on the water/ice for the event before the Act 2 Boss (Aranthos) was added: it is now just a random event like any other, instead of always being the breaking ice event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/a272152da936a5efd706d11ba8c25e8e7a227d3a.jpg[/img]
All lights spawned by events are removed, making their looks more consistent. All cutscenes have been improved, especially making the movement speed of the camera more consistent.

[h2]And?[/h2]
The HP Shield of Bosses now have a different color instead of plain red, with a custom one for each boss! The overhead UI of immortal units was darkened to make it more clear that they are immortal, and added an FX to bosses when they block hits because they are not the last unit yet:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/3cbe5c32fa150bd1ec8509e14e9c4ffe60a07913.jpg[/img]
The the hair and attack of Lung of Mythenmetz now have a purple touch to make it visually clearer that his attacks do not use the fire damage or ground inflaming mechanic. Slightly modified the Fire Phenomenon attack particle system for the same reason.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/fba9a5760c495468b2fb2761bf1491248bd8b73a.jpg[/img]

And a long list of smaller but no less important changes:
[list]
[*][b]Added an automatic save and load system for runs![/b]
[*]Added an effect for the Demon Totem after rotation that shows which tiles of the cube need yet to be solved
[*]Added a counter how many units still have to be defeated in the top right. Can be clicked to mark all units that still have to be defeated (i.e., the effect ignores immortal enemies)
[*]Improved unit placing UI such that units no longer "get lost" above the screen with the need to scroll down to see them
[*]Added Earth Wyrm and Phoenix to the possible starting units (if unlocked)
[*]Made Earth Wyrm darker and more brownish to improve glance value (tm) versus Elder Wyrm
[*]Clarified in the unbound status that it only applies to kills during unit movement
[*]Fixed the scale and spinning wheel events sometimes incorrectly rotating the units offered
[*]Fixed Burial Urn never being actually offered in events despite being unlocked
[*]Esc and Backspace now close the small Esc-Menu, the Settings Menu and the Manual (instead of opening Esc-Menu over them or doing nothing)
[*]Clarified in Isabella's description that she does not drown
[*]Fixed Krios the Martyr triggering his attack on own units
[*]Made the 4th cube requirement unlock level 6 (that of Earth Wyrm) instead of depending on the unlock score (so that the level does not get unlocked in the middle of a run)
[*]Made the keyword hovering UI fade out faster the further away the mouse is from the border of the UI
[*]Fixed restarting a run while in an event unit selection breaking unit placement visuals for the following run 
[*]Clarified and streamlined lots of relic and unit texts, especially whether their effects are permanent or just for the current cube, and whether a count is resetted after a cube
[/list]

[h2]Last Words[/h2]
And as a little concluding easteregg, if you enjoy a little bit of "how the sausage is made", I(and ChatGPT) also created a nice system that samples and plots the new spawn patterns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/082f307747a42a94c4146ea4c9295cc416163c75.png[/img]
It shows a sample of some random spawns, and for each the total sum of all hitpoints of opponents on a cube, the total sum of all hitpoints of non-invincible units, the number of units and and the number of invincible units of a spawn pattern. (Difficulty means the act: act 1 (left), act 2(middle) and act 3 (right), and the three colors show the three different patterns per cube).


That's it! The secret is out! See you on June 18th!!

[h2]Addendum of May 30th[/h2]
Another Update got pushed, with some smaller improvements:
[list]
[*]Reduced the on disk size of the game by 40% by being less dumb when packaging
[*]Fixed cube rotation sometimes skipping the current song
[*]Background music playlist system should be more reliable in general now
[*]Fallen Deluder now ignores immortality and boss block
[*]Fixed Drunk Demon of Sand not blocking other Demon placement
[*]Fixed Deja-Vu Potion incorrectly showing its cork after save&load when used
[/list]
(This means all bugs from the current pre-recorded stream are fixed now lol)

Also, there is now a pretty FX when one demon blocks another from placing:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/e6361417631ad7153d8c9cb764e40b138fe12f20.jpg[/img]

Also: Watch this space! You guys might now really soon the date for the Early Access Release of this very game...

notes.title: Untitled Unsettled Update
notes.content:
Ho, ho, ho! Santa's here. Or the easter bunny or who cares.

This little fellow brings you a completely redone game win experience! 
Now, there are two dozen different variants of the ending cutscene! (Wait! This means we have an ending cutscene now?!?) Expect more to come. Try to find out the conditions for each variant, and let me know in the discord if you think you found some, he!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/8345167dcea255c5b8955ea748691e5542df9807.gif[/img]

This update also contains some visual sugar, and various quality of life improvements. See, exempli gratia, this shiny effect to the Overhead UI of invincible units:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/174fc3a4dc275269c137bbbbf381471ecd142440.gif[/img]
Or this visual effect when Iron Knights or Lead Knights push something:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/445a7da8580b8d3ad5e62c493956a4f1c41dbf3e.jpg[/img]
Added a marker in the tutorial at the "Cube Face Turns II" Stage for units that were not killed after a rotation:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/a5426c234c910e4fde42d8d4826ce1ccf6351e0b.jpg[/img]
Added help tips when all your units are dead, all units are stuck or the player has been playing the same cube for a very long time, to clarify that the game is not immediately lost, but that the player has to decide when it is considered hopeless to continue.

And some other things:
[list]
[*] Winning a game now grants you 5 extra unlock score points
[*] Fixed Spinning Wheel event beeing able to be clicked while wheel is spining.
[*] Removed one frame of lag when winning a cube (hopefully)
[*] Fixed Aranthos and Xuhivan Levels spawning units that were not yet unlocked instead of substituting them with unlocked units
[*] Fixed a bit of unit jittering on the first cube of act 2 (Cow Dome)
[*] Greatly increased sized of click hitboxes in the following events (all have no choice that needs to be made): Magic Portal, Ice Blocks, Magic Mirror, Dragon Statue, Shrine of Theris, Upgrade Unit Event.
[/list]

notes.title: Ginormous Amendments of Advent
notes.content:
Guten Tag,

contrary to what I said last time, I packed a lot of stuff into this update again! Life also got in the way, and not exactly in a positive way. So, sorry, for taking my time with this rather late christmas present.

A doubling of 10 to 21 Events, two new demon units, and 1 (in numbers ONE) new relic are accompanied by a new smooth (Skyrim-Style, in case you remember that, ha!) log system, and multiple QoL adjustments especially in the unlock system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/af630a66a0c047d2a5bc726b123805170d6d4027.jpg[/img]
There is now a purple something to more clearly mark curse relics:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/b5ea0d9770c1023f2042652de31bab15103a416b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Two new Demons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/67dc4419ffe2983ae52a0a0296652bebce54ed14.jpg[/img]
[b]Demon_Totem[/b]
[i]Demon[/i]. [i]Immortal[/i]. [i]Inert[/i]. Does not move or attack. You cannot win a cube unless the side the totem demon is standing upon is [i]solved[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/27f3e3b074daac7953c39d6506c903a7df3324e3.jpg[/img]
[b]Krampus[/b]
[i]Demon[/i]. [i]Aquatic[/i]. [i]Immortal[/i]. [i]Seeks[/i] only own units. Attacks in a [i]cone[/i] before him. Only hits units of the same team.

[h3] New Events:[/h3]
In this update we get quite a lot of new events. They are now unique per run, instead of just always a random one at each event location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/6f590b6d42da548ca88ee4dd5353d7de45d1bd79.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/5bae196f6e716cec665ccc8116458828f0ac11d5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/d3d18ee8047514549dd9019df74ba540ccad563c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/225e2e08a439df5686e1498d09c3c82f270625e2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/e6d443e85f0a22d8948800a95b513629eee705b8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/4a10597c7f046ad32c8606eeafa9820791bfa66b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/4ffae6885da61f6d8a61dcf6fc0024afe235577d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/bed52dc0f245ca23fa4e701d21caeeb55dc60e46.jpg[/img]

There are also two new events that only unlock later:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/201fa28346945556203f3bfc37a6e2ed61c28ea9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/397bcec202d3830ecff6816d58711957edc2a6db.jpg[/img]
Since they are now introduced and we have some, expect a couple more events interacting with demons!


[h3]And now about the highlight of this update:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/f732b6f932d3b95d8661abe06a33a541dcc15a83.jpg[/img]
(Hope you like it!)

This also shows you the new and exciting System which allows you to right click zoom into stuff you unlocked! Unlocking multiple unlock levels at once now  also show directly after each other, instead of requiring a restart, and using the escape menu to go into the main menu now always shows the unlock screen, even though the next unlock level is not reached.

[h3]Small changes and bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Demon Prince ignoring block
[*] The telescope event now also removes all statuses instead of just giving the pure status (the actual difference in behaviour is very minuscule, but this is more consistent)
[*] Fixed regular relic list not beeing shuffled
[*] Fixed a rare bug with boss music where two songs could be played simultaneously
[/list]

notes.title: Gigantous Fall Update
notes.content:
Hey Hey!

Long has it been. This time I took a bit of a different approach, and packed lots and lots of content into this update. It contains [b]4[/b] new units, [b]2[/b] new events, and [b]25[/b] (TWENTY-FIVE (if I have not miscounted, I am not good at that stuff)) new relics!

Take it as a christmas present that came early (I am very sorry for reminding you that it is only 51 days untill christmas). For example, there now are more sophisticated inside material for cubes! So there is no longer plain white gleaming at you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/0d1e84b8724434d9b115d0cf5d74653b0202132c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/f44059937581baa0655d47487c3c753e48c2da24.jpg[/img]
Other small and not so small changes and bugfixes include (demo and full game):
[list]
[*] Fixed mouse position for the visual rotation of a cube or relic not beeing polled every tick (massive difference in perceived responsibility)
[*] Bump collision FX on the ground now lingers way longer (to make it clearer when a collision occured)
[*] Made the bumping collision FX more consistent with 2x2 units: Now always plays the FX on the tiles that were actually part of a collision and on no others
[*] Fixed a bug with wrong relic placement on non-16:9 screen ratios, and 3rd column of units not beeing visible on 4:3 screens  
[*] Made The GroundHelpTip Makrer Marker on the cube more visible and linger longer
[*] Added a sound to fire on ground hitting a unit
[*] Fixed DisarmFX beeing broken for unplaced units
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the facing direction of 2x2 units would be sometimes rotated twice when rotating a cube face
[*] Fixed the new cube added in the last update trying to spawn in demo, and sometimes spawning over bosses
[*] Fixed that cube sometimes spawning phoenixes out of bounds (was visual only)
[*] Fixed Orb of Love mentioning some guy called Ramnik (who is that???)
[*] Guardian of Love is now replaced by Guardian of Light on Very Easy in events instead of just beeing blocked from the spawn list
[*] Jade Soldiers of the first boss fight no longer spawn in the tutorial (to avoid very often showing 2 help tips there)
[*] The spinning wheel event now places random cursed relics (see below) instead of always Hand of Brass (stays Hand of Brass in Demo)
[/list]

[h3]Now, to the new content:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/6000ba948c7044eaf0ddf3e53c26edf561195347.jpg[/img]
[b]Rainbow Sentinel[/b]
Before units move, apply [i]Disarm[/i] to all units on the cube side the sentinel is standing on. Does not [i]seek[/i] or attack. Four Rainbow Sentinel [i]fuse[/i] into one [i]Rainbow Sergeant[/i].

[b]Rainbow Sergeant[/b]
[i]Hovering[/i]. Before units move, apply [i]Immortal[/i] to all units on the cube that are [i]disarmed [/i](Works immediately on disarm triggered by [i]Rainbow Sentinel[/i]). Does not [i]seek[/i] or attack. May float over water.

[b]Orb of Light[/b]
Before units move, apply [i]Immortal [/i]to all units on the cube that are [i]disarmed[/i]. (Note: This is applied before unit effects, so it will take an additional turn to apply when units trigger a disarm)

[b]Liquid Love[/b]
[i]Disarms[/i] all units on the targeted cube side. One Charge.

These units and relics are connected: Since [i]immortal[/i] units do not have to be defeated, these in combination provide another way to clear a cube besides brute force. It's just a tad more complicated. (Don't worry: This stuff is unlocked later, so as to not overstrain the last brain cells you have left after reading this).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/43fc4b253281cc597d1b0faec7f6131ed6ee0727.jpg[/img]
[b]Drunk Demon of Sand[/b]
[i]Demon[/i]. [i]Immortal[/i]. [i]Aquatic[/i]. Turns on obstacle collision. Starts with the status [i]Sand[/i] [i]of[/i] [i]Time[/i], which cannot be removed. Does not [i]seek[/i] or attack.


This update introduces the concept of [b]demon[/b] units. There may only be one demon (of any type) placed on a cube side, so if you get to many, you will automatically lose the cube. Additionally, each demon has a special (negative) effect: In the case of the [i]Drunk Demon of Sand[/i] this means that each rotation that affects her cost you an additional turn on the clock!
You get [i]demons [/i] by special events, and not by the regular unit events (don't tempt me!). For example by the event seen in the background: 
It let's you either turn back the time by 3, or by 10, but gives you a Drunk Demon of Sand in the latter case!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/847fcc06a507efc94ab4d99f7d99b2ef8cda59f8.jpg[/img]
[b]Starship's Wheel[/b]
For every four (own or enemy) units drowned, turn the time back by one.

[b]Captain's Wheel[/b]
[i]Cursed[/i]. For every six (own or enemy) units drowned, turn the time forward by two.

[b]Cursed Anchor[/b]
[i]Cursed[/i]. Drowned units no longer respawn.

[b]Pirate's Skull[/b]
If your clock exceeds 33 rotations (two thirds of maximum rotations), get a random potion every time you win a cube.

As there are [b]demon[/b] units, there are [b]cursed[/b] relics: You do not really want them, but sometimes there is just no way around! They are given to you in various events, for example, the spinning wheel event now places them sometimes instead of always a Hand of Brass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/10aa8c5b4e8bd56c2c9c2302ab0d5f01cd34391f.jpg[/img]
[b]Demon Prince[/b]
[i]Demon[/i]. [i]Massive[/i]. [i]Immortal[/i]. [i]Attacks[/i] the four tiles in front of him. For each demon besides this one, he attacks two more rows of four in front of him.

Did I just say that you do not really want demons? Well, that's not always true, the Demon Prince is a regular unit, and it gets stronger with all demons you have! But be careful: The placing constraint still holds

[b]Burial Urn[/b]
Whenver you gain a [i]cursed[/i] relic, turn the clock back by 3.

This is also to give an exception to the rule that curse relics are supposed to be bad (I hope you like how I design games?)

[b]Undo Potion[/b]
Unplace all your units on the current cube, and place them again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/12117d23657a9075da53aa391b798bc5432dd5a7.jpg[/img]
[b]Heroine's Effigy[/b]
Your units no longer [i]fuse[/i] when you own the required amount of a unit type.

Contrary to what you might think, this relic is actually good for you: Most upgrades are indeed better than the base unit, but since it often takes you three or more of the base unit to [i]fuse[/i], this is still a net positive.

[b]Trinket Box[/b]
Adds one [i]Treasure Chest[/i] to the enemies randomly spawned on each cube.

[b]Treasure Chest[/b](unit)
[i]Immortal[/i]. [i]Aquatic[/i]. [i]Inert[/i]. Does not attack. When first attacked, turn the clock back by 1.

[b]Staff of the Seraphim[/b]
Your units no longer [i]fuse[/i] when you own the required amount of a unit type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/ea1d73763d6502cb1160a541adc237a42e589fc8.jpg[/img]
[b]Ink and Quill[/b]
On pickup, gain three random potions. Every rotation rotates the cube twice (180°).

[b]Old Emblem[/b]
Turn the clock back by 20. Every rotation rotates the cube twice (180°).

[b]Tree Seal[/b]
Turn the clock back by 20. Cube faces can only be rotated clockwise.

These three relics are heavy stuff, for those of you who feel their brain has not been tortured enough. They sit at the very end of the unlock list, completely transforming how the game works.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/14b6ff22487054f796356a6d2cb90c52fe30298c.jpg[/img]
The other new event, this telescope thing there, lets you choose between the following things:
(Left): Pick one of your units to permanently apply [i]Pure[/i] to it. (Middle): Add an [i]Ancient[/i] [i]Knowledge[/i] to your relics. (Right): Upgrade one of your units.
Right or Left Click to choose.

[b]Ancient Knowledge[/b]
At the start of each cube, apply the status [i]Immortal[/i] to all units of type ???. (Unit type varies per run)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/98f263ff1631d99a9208c2d900371411f93f23e5.jpg[/img]
You already know the [i]Phoenix[/i]! Yet, the two relics are new, and give you yet another way to win: By improving how good fire is! (And since the phoenix is one of the units that sets stuff on fire, maybe you get why they are grouped with it)

[b]Eastern Fire[/b]
Fire may now also spread onto water.

[b]Detective's Pipe[/b]
Fire kills hit units instantly instead of damaging them.


[h3]Now, lets get to some other relics that are always unlocked:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/ec724f5cc06ded5a34c890460cafec1e2549185a.jpg[/img]
[b]Leather Hat[/b]
Every time you win a cube in one rotation, get a random potion.

[b]Helm of Quarhodron[/b]
If you use a potion, gain a new one of the same type. Two charges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/c50d8d7847b60779eed6daa299e880322fd7b03c.jpg[/img]
[b]Beckoning Bell[/b]
[i]Cursed[/i]. Adds two ??? to the enemies randomly spawned on each cube. (Unit type varies per run)

[b]Demon Mask[/b]
[i]Cursed[/i]. Whenever you use a potion, turn the clock forward by 1.

[b]Cast Satan[/b]
[i]Cursed[/i]. On pickup, turn the clock forward by 5.

These are the three basic curse relics. Hand of Brass is now unlocked later (as it felt rather complicated).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/0850513940f24bd4315854a706533afd0f9b6195.jpg[/img]
[b]Bent Spoon[/b]
Every third of your [i]unbound[/i] units does not get removed on death.

[b]Liquid Fire[/b]
If the targeted unit has an upgrade, upgrade it for this cube, if not, make it take one [i]Fire Damage[/i] and [i]inflame[/i] the ground the unit is standing on. Target must be standing on cube. One Charge. 

[b]Reorder Elixir[/b]
Unplace all enemy units on the current cube, and place them again. (Unlocked actually pretty late lol)




This is it for now, hope you even read to the end, lol? Up to next adventures, I'll try to keep up the pace! I will probably return to updates sized a bit smaller and more frequently though for the foreseeable future.

notes.title: More Cubes for the Addicted
notes.content:
Wassup!

Some of you guys will probably remember the tease, and here it is now, playable for the full version: A new cube to grind your gears against!
The cube will not be available right at the start, you will have to do some unlocks first. I plan on adding some more cubes soon, and I have not decided on how best to put them into the game, so if you have any ideas just let me know!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/6c81cc24631ab18b807f48407ed89f46052d0391.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/08f7cf9aea23ecf4095b1c03f5f77ce2fe57563a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/e433e05c51b6ebce24e487f68e0044fcdd98b3a6.jpg[/img]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed units with inherent Statuses (High King of Love) not getting them when spawned on a cube instead of being placed by the player (this could not happen in the game before, but can happen on the new cube!).
[*] Fixed Elder Wyrm (Upgrade of Earth Wyrm) always beeing unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: Simplifications for Simple Minds
notes.content:
I heard some of you guys still had problems finishing the demo (or the tutorial, lol), so I made the game even simpler, ha! No shaming here (No, no, not at all)

The following simplifications were made (all apply to the demo and the full game).

Tutorial:
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of units spawned on the second tutorial cube
[*] Made the third and fourth cube be always the same
[/list]
Added a new unit, the Guardian of Light
[list]
[*] Replaces the Guardian of Love on the Very Easy difficulty and in the tutorial
[*] Has the same attack pattern, but does not seek own units, or gains hitpoints on kills
[*] Does not upgrade into the High King of Love or anything else
[*] Guardians of Love no longer spawn on the forest side of one of the three starter cubes on Very Easy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/210dc6fdb09028f6cdacf6248ae91851fb2cecd3.jpg[/img]
[/list]
Tutorial and Very Easy:
[list]
[*] Reduced the random starting units and gave you more of the simpler to use units (Guardian of Light and Krios. You have now more units in total)
[/list]
Tutorial, Easy, and Very Easy:
[list]
[*] Units now turn when they run into an obstacle, just as they always do when reaching the edge of the cube.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/814132a0c1af41f30cbb7093303ada850154b6bc.gif[/img]
[/list]
Normal:
[list]
[*] You now start with the relic Orb of Elemental Love: It reverts the above change such that units now get stuck at blocked obstacles again (Massive units still as before).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/38ab927b3d23a5d24c70b8cb2c657d000acacade.jpg[/img]
[/list]

(Also, I moved help tip /tutorial windows closer to the edge of the screen)

notes.title: More Quality of Life and Clarity
notes.content:
Salvete Lusores!

The new update is coming, making your life easier, and this game hopefully easier to understand!

[h1]Demo Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug with Telkas projectile in strange cases not showing the intense glow at its edge correctly when it is ready to explode
[*] Added a system to show the attack pattern of units you placed. This should also make it easier to see the rotation of units you are placing
[*] The pattern will also be shown if you hover over units already placed on the cube. 
[*] Not that it is no simulation of a move though, it does not take into account damage block, attacks that ignore blocks, hitpoints, or friendly fire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/29bbd519f18977080b1d7fca90bc71755c729f69.gif[/img]
[*] Also, and this was way more work than it probably seemed, added a new "Bumping" System for units to show when they were trying to move to the same location, thus blocking themselves, with movement of the units, FX and sound
[*] A smaller version also plays when units try to move into obstacles
[*] Previously they were just standing still, which seemed to confuse some of you
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/b408b126ccdb2909adf71c559dae22635bcc1f8e.gif[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Of Scaled Birds and Magic Portals
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

A new update is coming today! Sorry I haven't posted in over a week, and new content gets pushed only now!

[h1]Demo Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Spectral Phenomenon and Fire Phenomenon sometimes not showing their attack (Hopefully the last time I have to write this lol)
[/list]

[h2]Beta Version Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Readded the promised Phoenix unit! A rare scaled bird held by the senators of Ko, with a ranged attack that enflames the ground on units it hits:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/01381101616224129da31c86eec4d869b5cde380.jpg[/img]
[*] The Phoenix loses one hit point every turn, but on dying its body does not get removed, but instead revives three turns after beeing killed:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/a6ca49646c117b22b85587a5b79818cf2aee191e.jpg[/img]
[*] Also, the Earth Wyrm now has an Upgrade, the Elder Wyrm! It works very similar to the Earth Wyrm, turning hit units into brass, but attacks all tiles in front of him in a straight line:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/6d1657b815b64538421e0a6c932970fd14062510.jpg[/img]
[*] On the events side of things, first there is this strange thing here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/f514268dd7cc023bc71e1f9e7212fa08473864d6.jpg[/img]
[*] And the Magic Mirror:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/33292e61d220611d174ecd5ad6ac85b37081d065.jpg[/img]
[/list]

Have fun with the new update! Lots of nearly finished stuff (teased in this update for example) is coming very soon!

notes.title: Clarifactions, Clarifications, Clarifications
notes.content:
Hey Folks! Based on your feedback after the last update, I added some small changes (mainly to the tutorial):

[list]
[*] Using the right or middle mouse button to visually "rotate" the cube is now called "spinning", while keeping "face turns" for the actual moves on the cube with the left mouse button (to stay with the usualy phrasing that is used with speedcubing and such).
[*] In help tips, such in the tutorial, now also adds a glowing edge if there is a "Got It" button that can be pressed (this will make it clearer if a window has to be closed to progress the tutorial).
[*] The Tutorial now spins you to the graveyard side if you are no longer looking at it while units are spawned.

[*] The Unit Overhead UI now always shows off a "1" for units that have 1 Hitpoint, instead of just showing a blank shield (can be turned off in menu for old behaviour). This will hopefully clarify that Dragon Monks only have 1 HP (why does everyone think otherwise rofl).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/c4607dfc8c6d39aaa7a1bb0fd72fa4bddf5f3cb9.png[/img]

notes.title: Brass & Taunt Update
notes.content:
Hey guys! It's time for an update again! Updates will come out in much smaller steps and more frequently now!

[h1]Demo Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the fish of the Koi Fish Relic sometimes rotating outside of the sphere
[*] Fixed Spectral Phenomenon and Fire Phenomenon sometimes not showing their attack
[*] Added Analytics to help balance the game (may be turned off in menu)
[/list]

[h2]Beta Version Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Everything also in the demo
[*] Finalized and added the Earth Wyrm unit: Flies above the ground (and water), and turns hit units into brass instead of damaging them (as they are then immortal, they do not need to be killed to win a cube then)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/ec030cadb31f83de8eee48da7f475ee5a0600a78.png[/img]
[*] Added the Swamp Dragon unit: Flies above the ground (and water), and blows enemies of the cube

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/5b1aa01dae924ca00c7a4a5cdc628414e28619c1.png[/img]
[*] Added an upgrade to the Guardian of Love, the High King of Love. Like the Guardian, but starts with three Hit Points, and starts with the taunt status effect

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/605603c345d65123964d2f17edf9602b1ba4bdb6.png[/img]
[*] Added a Dragon Slayer Statue event: Pick any of your units to apply taunt to it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/dc2ae1a2d2fefb01b21b65088c02f6490928ac67.png[/img]
[*] Added a new status effect: Taunt. Units with the status taunt will be prioritized when getting seeked
[*] Stopped unfinished Phoenix unit being offered. Will be finished and readded very soon
[/list]
 
Expect lots of nearly finished content to be added over the next couple of days!

notes.title: Quality of Existence Update
notes.content:
Hey Folks!
This update adds a lot of quality of life features I added to the demo while still working hard on the full game! Also, some [strike]bugs[/strike], eh, unique feature changes (there are no bugs, only happy little accidents).


[h2]New Preview System for Cube Rotations![/h2]
To make it easier to see which face a drag on the cube will actually rotate, the game now shows smoothly a small preview rotation while the mouse is dragged:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/87b933d35a2761e1fc10671b08e6034b215ada63.gif[/img]

[h2]New Marker System for Unit Placing![/h2]
To make it clearer whether you are right now trying to place a unit on the cube, but the field is blocked, there now is a green or red marking on the ground while dragging a unit onto the cube in the unit placing phase:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/d05661142b0ef4fe323895cb8e54d887472533f5.gif[/img]

[h2]Added a Join Discord Button to the Main Menu[/h2]
JOIN THE DISCORD FOLKS: https://discord.gg/cg9TKMaJBS

[h2]Completely new Store Page[/h2]
Well, at this point you will have seen it, but we have a completely new store page, trailer, screenshots, Steam Art, and much more!

[h2]Some other Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made Krios the Martyr deal and be immune to Fire Damage, and inflame the ground when hitting other units (like casting Bottled Flame)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/e90167e2ba8cdb4a38dc5dfe9c418b1948a48c1c.gif[/img]

[*]Made the Wheel of Fortune Event and Upgrade Unit Event actually spawn (instead of just being unlocked)
[*]You now have to complete the "Very Easy" difficulty to unlock the "Easy" difficulty, and the "Easy" difficulty to unlock the "Normal" difficulty. 
[i](Note: If you want to skip to the highest difficulty, press ^ to open the console, and type "RunCubeCheat SetDiffUnlock 0" (0 is "Normal" difficulty, -1 is "Easy" difficulty, and -2 is "Very Easy" difficulty))[/i]
[*]Tweaked the loss screen slightly, and added music to it!
[/list]

[h2]Some Quality of Life Changes [strike]and bugfixes[/strike][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new Message when an upgrade to a unit is not in the demo, instead of just displaying that it is not unlocked
[*]Added a marker in Esc Menu when the Main Menu has new unlocks
[*]Lots of streamlining of edge cases to make execution order more predictable
[*]Added an option to show the execution order including a help tip
[*]Events where you pick one of your units (such as the upgrade event) now show the instructions at the bottom of the pick screen as well


[*]Increased FPS when rotating a cube by ~30% (No typo)
[*]Fixed help tips sometimes not being properly positioned
[*]Fixed camera glitching when ending the Wheel of Fortune Event
[*]Fixed UnplacedUnitsUI not beeing removed when winning a cube while in unit placing menu (Probably extremely rare for you, but this happened frequently for me when testing the game)
[*]Fixed Spectral Phenomenon and Fire Phenomenon glitch over the cube when being pushed to another cube (e.g., by a Lead Knight) than the one they were actually standing on
[*]Fixed the failsafe system to unstuck units when bugs cause them to indefinitely block rotations sometimes not triggering (actually irrelevant for production because my programming is flawless and never had any bugs lolqop)
[*]Fixed arrows sometimes getting stuck and floating in air after the according unit was destroyed
[*]Fixed units being able to have less than 1 HP despite being alive when revived (Didn't make much of a difference though)
[*]Multiple Lead Knight and Iron Knights pushing the same unit around now properly stacks

[/list]


You can now play this update!!

notes.title: BIIIG Update II
notes.content:
Hello Folks,

Christmas came, as did the new year, and here we are. Eh bien, continuons! In this update, we will focus on the new content added to the demo.

[h1]Added Potions to the game![/h1]

[h2]Bottled Flame[/h2]
Inflame the targeted ground. One Charge.

A tiny flame, made eternal while it considers the philosophical implications of its existence in a jar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/30cafc3ef8b0efacf47bb515ba8139aff469fc8e.png[/img]
Many more fire mechanics are to come!

[h2]Black Lotus Tea[/h2]
Get three Kamos to place on this cube. If you are not in the unit placing phase, reenter it. One Charge.

All smiths are supposed to practice hammering a teapot when first discovering their modelling abilites, often resulting in works of paltry quality. In this special case, a peculiar bright scholar filled this one with a concoction made of the black lotus, a worthless hallucinogenic weed ubiquitous all over the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/da2a1cc01ff698e5c85bcd7eea7e9ac43cf252ed.png[/img]

[h2]TauntPotion[/h2]
Turn all opponent units such that they are looking at the target unit. One Charge.

A potion distilled of the sweat of a dragon's scales, enriched with the alchemist's dark rage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/7f298cdcc0d76d10b7f6a73138bfd65f91d57690.png[/img]

[h2]Liquid Water[/h2]
Removes all Statuses from a unit, and turns it Pure. Three charges.

Distilled elixir caught of the steam fuming from the Elemental Orb of Water, left behind by Orphelia as a parting gift to Xuhivan when she left his Cube. It is the only part of the Element that still remains in his possesion, indistinguishably just water after all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/3aa34b258c67294a1b4f1963772e48c912d6cf51.png[/img]

[h2]Liquid Brass[/h2]
Turn a unit into brass, permanently if you control it. One Charge.

A small bottle filled of the brazen rivulet that flowed down the inner marketplace of the city of Mir. When its towers still stood tall, it was custom among travellers to carry one home as keepsake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/01b1ffeacceea6cb8bc76cff18f2799606bf912e.png[/img]

[h2]Aged Wine[/h2]
All units on the cube move one step without attacking or seeking each other. Does not influence the clock. One charge.

Greatly aged whine of mediocre quality, pressed by Gizzard von Ulfo, of grapes harvested when Nizos' star was at his peak. They who drinks of it will rejoice their veins filled with the desire for love, dance, an insatiable desire to move one's feet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/47dbff8ae4150fc1bf35c320c828538a81c79737.png[/img]

[h2]Sweetened Honey[/h2]
Change the team of any unit. One Charge.

Magic honey distilled in Tol'i Vinlamad, the capital of the islands of Faranga. Sweetened with the water of its mountain springs by the followers of Khardimon it becomes so obnoxiously dulcet that it makes one forget all loyalties.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/85bc27af8c2c946605d1de9d819c731d9eaab3f1.png[/img]

[h2]Immortality Potion[/h2]
All your units revive on death for this cube. One Charge.

Tears of Adanos, a fictional deity made up by Quarhodron and his heirs, who sent the flood for which they built their arch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/2c99003a90af7be326d1d8e45d1fc157e1c403f2.png[/img]

[h2]Polarity Oil[/h2]
Invert the facing direction of all units on the cube. One Charge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/2574aa66311615780cd412b78269acf96d67724e.png[/img]

[h2]BottledLighting[/h2]
Bottled Lighting is also now a potion


[h1]New Relics![/h1]

[h2]Rare[/h2]
Can be used once per cube. Get two <key id="Unit_Kamos">Kamos</> to place on this cube. If you are not in the unit placing phase, reenter it. {Prefix} {Suffix} (Affixes vary per run)

Loot taken when slaying monsters in the Blood Moor. Its properties are unique, but if everything is unique, what truly is? More valuable than if it would be uncommon, but less so than if it would be legendary.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/27a5b938a5d917db12519016231db9b25687a3b0.png[/img]

[h2]Weapon[/h2]
Can be used once per cube. Target any unit on the cube. {Prefix} {Suffix} (Affixes vary per run)

Magic artefact won gambling in a rogue encampment, special like every corn of sand is. How it came there is dubious, and it is quite unclear why this specific object may travel with such ordinary fellows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/34d0486f9fdb93b63f623ec63c7e2f33e11fa520.png[/img]

[h2]Hand of Brass[/h2]
The first unit you place on any cube will permanently become Brazen. Can be reset if all units are unplaced.

A famous monkey king was gifted three wishes by a kindred god. On his first wish, he wished for nothing, as he lived a full life within his family. But soon those craved for opportunity, he was pressured into wishing second that he could gain immeasurable riches and the last thing he touched each evening would turn to brass in the morning. As the story tells, over the years everyone close to him fled for the risk of becoming eternal memorial, so at last alone, instead of making a third wish, he got drunk with wine of Ulfo and fell asleep with his head tucked under his hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/4601c3b9dcfbb9ec512686e6cfbd680b47674ee0.png[/img]

[h2]Alchemist's Mask[/h2]
Whenever you use a potion, turn the clock back by 1.

The death mask of Riordian, brass rusted in water as proof of their worship of the god Adanos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/c937b7e8afecf7ea49d3b7a5c66f92d63414fe2b.png[/img]


That's it for now! Stay tuned for the next part of the Update!

notes.title: BIIIG Update
notes.content:
Hello Folks,

long has it been, I haven't been idle all this time but working hard. Today, you guys can finally reap the results of this hard work with this massive update!The next one won't take as long, I promise. ;D

For the sake of clarity I will split this update post into multiple smaller ones. Everything is already in the version you can download, but it will just be described later!

[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
We are now professionals and have one! Beautiful, no?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/9775363cb6a8309b50a2614a0217bab51413283a.png[/img]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
The game now has a proper tutorial, such that it can teach you how to push which buttons when!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/59a1bf851909729fd2017961094271bc2375ae7f.png[/img]
[h3]Units now Unlock![/h3]
Including fancy fireworks if you do:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/537c75b97789105ee2117856926c6acf231a7fb5.png[/img]
[h3]Hover System:[/h3]
If you hover over some keywords, a small help window will show up. This also shows the attack patterns of units beside the pure description in words.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/baa7fcfea9ed6a79972b7b8aa77a1e24ccfeab76.jpg[/img]
[h3]Settings Menu[/h3] (can you believe this technology was possible??)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/cf5c43c84225d01ff24e083cc1570ad97b7ef999.png[/img]
[h3]Upgraded from Unreal Engine 4.27 to Unreal Engine 5.3[/h3]

This means we could (subjunctive) now profit from massive such as Lumen and Nanite, as well as lots of under the hood improvements, and way better performance for me when using the unreal editor now (not that you care).


Lots of other small backend changes that will make development (hopefully) more predictable, less error-prone and faster in general

Spent months fixing a bug in the Unreal Engine Source Code regarding cloth simulation. (fml). On the bright side, I now know quite a lot about Position Based Dynamics Cloth Simulation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315698/90185332e5e27c98e4c14c9a1fb163575db1b2f9.png[/img]
[h3]
Lots of added Content! Multitude of QoL changes![/h3]

Stay tuned! I'll talk about that in the next update.

notes.title: Xuhivan's Autonomous Cube Developer Playthrough and Q&A
notes.content:
Xuhivan's Autonomous Cube is a Roguelike Autobattler on a Magic Cube. You have to place your units on the cube, and rotate the faces in such a way that it is beneficial for you. Use powerful and unique relics, and fight mighty bosses.

We will play through the game together and start a couple of runs, while I explain mechanics of the game, and talk about design choices. If you have any questions, let me know in the chat, 

Don't forget to Wishlist, and join the Discord: https://discord.gg/cg9TKMaJBS
